verdict.rationale: Trilegal is a full-service Indian law firm, a professional-services provider rather than a software product, so asking whether it ships an official CLI is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships one: the llms.txt file, the web-based DPDPA assessment tool and the absent OpenAPI endpoints do not indicate a CLI. Confidence is medium because the firm does publish some machine-readable web assets, but none brings a CLI within scope.
